english.title: Postal services - fail to remove postal service signs / letter box as required by universal service provider
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a notice given to you by the universal service provider, namely **(..SPECIFY PROVIDER..), requiring you to

(A)_[remove or efface, from an item or place, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), the words "letter box" accompanied with words, letters or marks which signified or implied or may reasonably have led the public to believe, that it was a universal postal service letter box]_
(B)_[remove or efface, from an item or place, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), words, letters or marks which signified or implied or may reasonably have led the public to believe, that it is a universal postal service letter office ]_
(C)_[remove or efface, from an item or place, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), words, letters or marks which signified or implied or may reasonably have led the public to believe, that it is a universal postal service letter box]_
(D)_[remove or efface, from a ship, vehicle, aircraft or premises, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), words, letters or marks which signified or implied or may reasonably have led the public to believe, that it was used by a universal service provider for the purpose of collecting, receiving, sorting, delivering or conveying postal packets in connection with the provision of a universal postal service]_
(E)_[remove or close up a letter box, namely **(..SPECIFY..), belonging to you or under your control which had ceased to be a universal postal service letter box]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 87(4) and (5) of the Postal Services Act 2000.
